name: @defra/cidm-stub
description: The CIDM stub is a lightweight, containerised Node.js application that replicates the external API interfaces of Customer Identity (CIDM) for use in performance, load, and integration testing by consuming service teams. The CIDM stub allows teams to run their authentication journeys end-to-end against a locally-hosted, self-contained stub rather than taking a dependency on a live Customer Identity environment. It is not a full standards-compliant identity provider and must not be used in production or in place of real security controls.
author: Defra DDTS

scripts.build: npm run copy:assets && npm run build:css
scripts.compose:cosmos:reset: npm run compose:cosmos:down && npm run compose:cosmos:up
scripts.compose:reset: npm run compose:down && npm run compose:up
scripts.copy:assets: rm -rf public/assets/govuk && mkdir -p public/assets/govuk && cp -R node_modules/govuk-frontend/dist/govuk/assets/images public/assets/govuk/images && cp -R node_modules/govuk-frontend/dist/govuk/assets/fonts public/assets/govuk/fonts && cp node_modules/govuk-frontend/dist/govuk/assets/manifest.json public/assets/govuk/manifest.json && cp node_modules/govuk-frontend/dist/govuk/govuk-frontend.min.js public/assets/govuk/govuk-frontend.min.js
